lines.text: The root is Vert! Convert, reverse.
Did you know? Vert is Latin for turn.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus turn?

words.ex: We converted the garage into a small office.
The driver reversed the car into the parking space.

publish.title: Vert root: convert and reverse
publish.value: Vert comes from Latin "vertere" (to turn). Words: convert and reverse. convert = con + vert; reverse = re + verse.
